sources.observation: The raised Hill Street screen has paired shafts, a cross set over the Holm glazing, a recessed balcony and seam metal roof.

sources.credit: Wikimedia Commons contributor, see image page
sources.observation: The central porch doors sit below a curved canopy, the fluted shoulders and brick approach stair.

limitations: Roof heights, upper bell openings and the Holm tracery are photo-based interpretations. Interiors are outside the scope.
